messages:
mira: Quick sync — proposing a small change to the mini-bench sampling strategy for onboarding. I’m calling it 'latency harmonics' — sample stratified across seq_len buckets and KV-cache states, then synthesize p50/p95/p99 harmonics to expose tail shifts early. Thoughts?

chen: Love the name. How is this different from our existing stratified sampler?

alex: Main diff is weighting by production request-frequency profile plus upsampling rare long-seq / kv-miss combos. Goal is to reduce long-tail blindspots. Tradeoffs: extra cost and potential false positives for tiny models.

sam: Interface question — where does sampling_profile live? bench harness config or intake gateway? We should avoid scattering config.

mira: Proposal: sampling_profile as part of model onboarding metadata (model.yaml). bench harness reads it. Minimal API change: sampling_profile: "harmonics-v1" plus optional overrides in the bench CLI.

tara: Quick local run example:
```
rbench run --model ./out/mymodel --profile harmonics-v1 --buckets "8,32,128,512" --kv-states "hit,miss,partial"
```

bench-bot: mini-bench/453 finished: harmonics-v1 run — p50 120ms, p95 430ms, p99 980ms. Tail dominated by bucket 512 / kv=miss.

chen: Nice signal. We need to decide gating criteria. Fail onboarding if p95 > 2x baseline? or if p99 > 1s? We must avoid spurious fails.

sam: Suggest two-tier gates: soft alerts on p95 drift (>1.3x baseline) so engs can triage; hard fail only if p99 crosses an absolute threshold (e.g. >1s) or if regression vs model family baseline is >2x. Also require a minimum sample size per bucket.

mira: Agree. Add confidence check: require N>=200 samples per bucket, otherwise escalate to deepbench for full validation.

alex: Ops concern: cost. Rough estimate +10–20% compute per model on average for harmonics. Can we run harmonics only on new major versions or models > X params, or schedule runs off-peak?

tara: Implementation notes for bench harness: emit sample metadata tags (seq_len_bucket, kv_state, sampled_weight) and per-bucket token counts. That makes aggregation straightforward in the console.

mira: Action items: chen — draft a short RFC with sampling_profile schema + gating examples; tara — add CLI flag and bench instrumentation; bench-bot team — add harmonics profile to the scheduled runs; sam — draft gating thresholds and escalation playbook. I’ll sync with product on whether gating should block deploy or just flag a ticket. :+1:

alex: I’ll run harmonics on the 7B family later today and post the run.

bench-bot: scheduled: harmonics sweep for model-group 7b at 2026-03-23T02:00Z.
